title: Institution-level post-quantum cryptography migration evidence
question: Which institutions are actually migrating to post-quantum cryptography?
why_it_matters: Standards create the migration clock, but operational impact depends on procurement, inventories, vendors, budgets, timelines, and critical infrastructure execution.
current_support: FTFN has the NIST PQC standards source and Published standards signal, plus Executive Order 14412 and OMB M-26-15 as a bounded federal implementation package requiring migration leadership, agency plans, risk prioritization, procurement work, modernization, a NIST pilot, and dated system transitions.
missing_evidence: completed Federal Acquisition Regulation changes and contract clauses
likely_source_types: institution-level implementation plan and completed milestone
candidate_records: agency PQC migration plan or progress report
proposed and final Federal Acquisition Regulation records
NIST pilot result and critical infrastructure migration guidance
next_action: Track the 120-day agency plan deadline, NIST pilot, CISA cryptographic bill-of-materials guidance, proposed FAR rules, and the first disclosed agency or sector implementation milestone before making a readiness claim.
notes: Phase 55B closes the guidance-selection gap with a current federal directive and implementation memorandum. The evidence gap remains open at the execution layer because requirements, plans, and deadlines do not prove migration completion.
